runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Generated Alpha 3 Skills committed in a disposable Git fixture; non-interactive exec; user configuration and project rules ignored; persisted child sessions; request restricted inspection to repository-generated resources.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only sandbox with approval policy never

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated poteto-mode router from the disposable fixture.
The root constrained its resource search to the fixture's generated .agents tree and project implementation and did not inspect installed Skill or plugin caches.
The router selected investigation for a read-only multi-module explanation request.
The investigation playbook loaded the generated how Skill and followed its complex path.
Exactly two explorer child threads started before the first wait.
The root froze both attributable results without follow-up, retry, or replacement.
Exactly one distinct explainer child started after the two explorer results froze.
The explainer received and retained the entry/queue and worker/store attribution from the two explorers.
The root re-read the critical implementation and integration test, then independently ran node --test project/test/report-system.test.mjs with 1/1 passing.
The final answer correctly explained composition, validation, normalization, ID assignment, FIFO processing, rendering, frozen storage, null-on-empty behavior, and caller-driven execution.
The project Git worktree stayed clean and all seven fixture source hashes matched; events.jsonl, final.txt, and stderr.log were runner artifacts outside project/.

limitations: Generated custom roles were not selectable on this CLI surface, so the explorer and explainer contracts were supplied inline.
User-level Cloudflare MCP authentication warnings appeared during startup despite --ignore-user-config; no MCP operation participated in the workflow.
No independently verifiable child model identity was exposed, so this record makes no model-diversity claim.
